result.summary: Target d428e0f730ed5649485732e95d39c32f5d6a8895 (feature/binary-config-serve-20260930). Verdict FINDINGS: 1 MEDIUM, reproduced. readArtifact (src/files.ts:94-98) derives the credential-screening overlap pad from only 2 of the 4 secret sources in redactorFor, omitting SWARMFORGE_API_TOKEN, which config.ts:81 leaves with no max length. Because Redactor.contains (security.ts:38-41) is an exact whole-secret match over the window, a read at offset > pad truncates such a credential at the window's left edge, no exception fires, and 804 contiguous bytes of a synthetic 5000-char token were returned to the caller. Right edge is sound; server_password is fixed 72 chars so that omission is latent. 91 in-scope tests pass; probe exits 1 only on the reproduced leak. Artifacts: /workspace/.swarmforge/artifacts/review.md and findings.json.
result.details:
Method: disposable detached worktree at /tmp/rev-24 with git rev-parse HEAD verified as the target; /workspace/repo left at assigned baseline 5672ead and clean. Official Bun 1.4.2 unpacked at /tmp/bun142 (snapshot 1.3.14 cannot read lockfileVersion 2); bun install --frozen-lockfile exit 0, lockfile never rewritten. Probe at /tmp/probe/probe.ts, outside the source checkout, used a fake byte-range WorkerProvider with a real Coordinator/Store/WorkerFiles and synthetic placeholder secrets only.

FINDING (MEDIUM, src/files.ts:94-98, screen at :103, return at :107). pad = max(4096, len(SWARMFORGE_MODEL_API_KEY), len(FREESTYLE_API_TOKEN)), but redactorFor (security.ts:44-49) screens four sources; SWARMFORGE_API_TOKEN is omitted and unbounded in config.ts:81. The overlap is only sound if the window holds one full secret past each edge, and the match is exact over the UTF-8 decode. So a read at offset > pad cuts an over-length credential at the left edge and returns up to secretLength-4097 of its bytes. Reproduced: token at bytes [0,5000), readArtifact(offset=4196, length=32768) gave pad=4096, window start=100 len=40960, no exception, 804 credential bytes returned matching the token prefix. Controls passed, isolating the left edge: short secret in-chunk refused; the same 5000-char token at byte 5000 refused; right-edge straddle refused; junk high bytes before an ASCII secret still detected (excludes UTF-8 decode consumption). Not prevented by tests/api.test.ts:104-127, the only screen test: it reads offset 0 (start clamps to 0) with 12-byte secrets, and no test reads a second chunk. Fix: compute pad from redactorFor(c).secrets() using Buffer.byteLength, and scan bytes rather than a decode.

Verified sound, recorded to avoid re-review: returned range is always a subset of the screened window; right edge sound; no false positives on binary (PNG-like, zlib, NUL) since the URL-userinfo regex cannot span a slash; get_worker_artifact is not wrapped in redactor.value but is safe because artifact() rejects credential-bearing paths; logs() redacts before slicing; the only other provider.readFile (result.json fallback, coordinator.ts:675) routes through complete() which redacts before store.finish; w.error is store-raw but every read surface redacts; the settings loader retains credential context from every layer including superseded values via withRedactionContext; commandRedactor adds JSON-escaped forms; excerptText redacts before trimming and takes the tail.

tests.summary: Targeted in-scope suites only: 91 tests pass, 0 fail, across api/excerpt/inspect/commands/settings. My own probe exits 1 solely because assertion A1 (no credential bytes returned) fails, which is the reproduced finding. bun install --frozen-lockfile exit 0; lockfile unmodified. Full suite not run (whole-suite reviewer's job); nothing compiled or packaged. No real cloud/model provider, VM, network service or real credential used - all providers are local fakes, all secrets synthetic.

warnings: The MEDIUM finding requires a SWARMFORGE_API_TOKEN longer than the 4096-byte pad floor. That is schema-legal (min 24, no maximum) and documented only as 'minimum 24 characters', so it is atypical; severity held at MEDIUM rather than HIGH for that reason.

The reproduction uses a fake provider honoring the documented byte-range contract (freestyle.ts:302-304 forwards {offset, length} to the SDK). The real SDK offset/length semantics were asserted from code, not exercised against real infrastructure.

Full test suite intentionally not run; only the four test files overlapping this scope. tests/packaging, serve, git-handoff, lifecycle, safety and others were not executed and may hide in-scope regressions.
The snapshot's system Bun is 1.3.14 and cannot read lockfileVersion 2; official Bun 1.4.2 was used from /tmp/bun142. The lockfile was never rewritten.
Rarer settings-loader false negatives (e.g. a credential inside a TOML inline table echoed by a parse error) were assessed by code reading only and remain unverified hypotheses, not findings.
result.followup_reason: MEDIUM credential-screening false negative in src/files.ts:94-98: the artifact chunk overlap pad is derived from 2 of the 4 secret sources in redactorFor, omitting the unbounded SWARMFORGE_API_TOKEN, so a read at offset > pad truncates an over-length credential at the window's left edge and returns up to secretLength-4097 of its bytes (reproduced: 804 bytes). Fix by computing pad from redactorFor(c).secrets() with Buffer.byteLength and screening raw bytes; add a regression test that reads a second chunk at offset > pad.
